newsitem.title: ITALY: BAA to sign airport deal in days - Naples.
newsitem.headline: BAA to sign airport deal in days - Naples.

text.p: The city of Naples said on Thursday that a deal in which British airport operator BAA Plc is set to buy a 65 percent in the city's Capodichino airport would be signed "in the next few days."

A statement issued by city government said: "After lengthy negotiations, an agreement was reached between BAA and the city and province of Naples for the acquisition by BAA of a majority stake in Gesac," the company which operates the airport. "The definitive 'yes' will be officially signed in the next few days," the statement said.
BAA signed a non-binding letter of intent with Gesac in January 1996. A spokeswoman for the airport said on Wednesday that BAA had agreed to buy a 65 percent stake.
Naples airport handled nearly 2.9 million passengers in 1996 and is the third biggest airport in Italy behind Rome's Fiumicino and Milan's Linate, the spokeswoman said.
